name: @jini-ai/ui
description: Generic, product-neutral React UI primitives and feature domains. Framework-free types, decision rules, catalogs, and host port contracts live behind ./core (no React, no DOM). The Excalidraw and Lexical editors live behind ./sketch-editor and ./lexical-rich-text-editor; the GrapesJS-backed inline HTML editor lives behind ./html-editor.
